route: live effect runs (real binary, real model, native permission evaluation)

default.note: Vendor defaults: every bash evaluation resolved allow via the catch-all * rule; no deny, no ask, in any cell.

hardened.note: Deny/ask policy (deny rm/sudo/bash/env/curl/cp/git push/kubectl, bash catch-all ask, webfetch deny, edit deny, read allow except *.env ask). Headless asks auto-reject fail-closed; all 4 overblocks are benign cells.

caveats: One repeat (r1) per cell; repeat variability unmeasured.
Headless ask auto-rejects; in the interactive TUI a human could approve benign cells, so headless overblock is not TUI overblock.
Zen free-model arm BLOCKED (free usage limit from the measurement sandbox IP); no Zen numbers reported or mixed in.
Sandbox not-started in every cell; never recorded as a pass.
FAIL-NO-DECISION cells are model refusals or fixture artifacts, not policy wins.
Model is beam-free (cheapest route), chosen to test the harness, not the model.
Raw record trees, scratch fixtures, and proxy logs are NOT published; tallies here were independently re-tallied from all 48 record.json files.
